A Snapshot of Your Day

You will join the Optimization & Validation team within the Turbine Control department, supporting the team in updating the wind turbine controller software for different turbine platforms.

Once a turbine platform is updated, you will use BHawC, our in-house aeroelastic wind turbine simulation code, to simulate the new controller. Then, using our MATLAB-based engineering tools, you will compare the new controller version with the previous one. You will review key turbine responses to verify that the turbine behaves as expected and identify any unexpected or unusual behavior.

Working closely with experienced colleagues, you will investigate differences between controller versions and help understand the reasons behind them. This will give you hands-on experience with wind turbine control, aeroelastic simulation, MATLAB-based engineering tools and controller validation, while contributing directly to the controller software used across our turbine platforms.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• 
You will maintain and update wind turbine models using MATLAB scripts, ensuring they align with engineering specifications.

• 
Simulate turbine behavior using BHawC.

• 
Analyze simulations to identify unexpected turbine behaviour and investigate the underlying causes.

• 
Ensure the quality of the controller updates by validating that the turbine behaves as expected across different operating conditions.

• 
Update and optimize MATLAB and Python scripts for generating turbine simulation reports.

• 
Generate detailed technical reports on turbine behavior using specialized tools and LaTeX, aiding in the tuning of turbine controllers.

• 
Contribute to our engineering toolbox by improving our existing tools or developing new ones.

• 
Maintain a list of the updated turbines in Jira.

What You Bring

• 
Currently enrolled in a Master’s degree programme in Wind Energy, Mechanical, Control, Aeronautical Engineering or a similar discipline, preferably with at least 1.5 years remaining.

• 
Experience or academic coursework in MATLAB and Python, particularly in programming, data processing, analysis, visualisation and engineering simulations.

• 
Solid understanding of wind energy engineering principles, control systems and mechanical/aeronautical engineering concepts.

• 
Proficiency in LaTeX for document preparation, technical report writing and simulation data interpretation.

• 
Experience with Git for version control of engineering tools and scripts.

• 
Strong critical thinking skills to analyse plots and detect outliers, ensuring the quality of each software version.

• 
Knowledge of BHawC or HawC2 would be an advantage but is not a requirement.

• 
Familiarity with Jira to keep track of the progress of your work.

• 
You are fluent in English, both written and spoken, as it is the primary language of our business.

About the Team

The Optimization & Validation team is part of the Turbine Control Department within R&D, consisting of six full-time employees and two student assistants based in a new office in Ballerup, Denmark. We are proud to be an international team with colleagues from four continents: North America, Europe, Africa, and Asia. Our team plays a key role in offshore wind turbine development projects, scoping and tuning controllers using BHawC simulations, supporting certification activities, coordinating controller changes with the Software Department, and discussing simulation results with Turbine Loads and component design teams. As projects progress towards prototype testing, we perform extensive validation activities, ensuring turbine and controller performance matches simulation predictions. Much of this work is based on data collected from our offshore turbines installed in Østerild. We encourage open technical discussions and value diverse engineering perspectives, welcoming constructive disagreement to identify problems and reach better technical decisions.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With +100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world’s electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character—no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

jobs.description:
Do you want to develop technical process solutions for customers across the world and play a key role in transforming customer requirements into competitive and reliable industrial systems? Then this could be your next position.

On behalf of Simatek A/S, we are looking for a Process Engineer who will become a central technical resource in the company's Process & Proposal team and contribute to the continued development of customer-specific process solutions for industries worldwide.

About Simatek

Simatek A/S is an international engineering company specializing in air filtration, pneumatic conveying, dust handling, and process solutions for industries such as food, feed, grain, recycling, minerals, and industrial manufacturing. The company designs and delivers customized systems that help customers improve operational efficiency, product quality, environmental performance, and workplace safety. From its headquarters in Albertslund in Denmark, Simatek serves customers around the world and combines strong engineering expertise with a flexible and customer-oriented approach.

The position

As Process & Application Engineer, you will become part of Simatek's international Process & Proposal team with colleagues in both Denmark and India. Focusing primarily on solutions for the food, dairy, feed and grain industries, you will transform customer requirements into technically robust and commercially competitive process solutions.

Working closely with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders, you will perform process calculations, size equipment, define system configurations and contribute to the development of tailored solutions that balance technical performance, cost efficiency and customer needs.

Your responsibilities will include

• Develop process solutions based on customer requirements and application data, identifying and solving technical issues in the process design

• Perform process calculations and system sizing for complete process installations

• Prepare and review process documentation

• Collaborate with suppliers regarding technical specifications and equipment selection

• Prepare technical proposals and quotations

• Contribute to the development and standardization of engineering tools, methods and solutions

• Work closely with R&D and the product management team to develop competitive solutions

• Support continuous improvement of process design standards and engineering practices

• Participate in occasional international travel for customer and technical meetings (approx. 20 days per year)

Your profile

We imagine you have a strong engineering background and experience developing process systems or technical solutions within industrial environments.

You likely bring:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree within Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Energy Engineering or a related discipline

• Experience within process engineering, system design or industrial solution development, with the ability to independently drive technical tasks

• Skilled in process calculations, equipment sizing and can read PFD and P&ID drawings

• Experience in preparing technical proposals, quotations or engineering project documentation is an advantage

• Experience from the food and dairy industry will be considered an advantage

• Professional proficiency in English. An additional language will be considered an advantage

As a person, you are analytical, solution-oriented and motivated by solving complex technical challenges. You work in a structured manner, take ownership of your tasks and enjoy collaborating across technical and commercial disciplines.

Why join Simatek?

You will join an entrepreneurial organization where the distance from idea to implementation is short, allowing you to make a tangible impact.

The role offers:

• Flexible working conditions including the possibility of working from home, up to two days per week by agreement

• Attractive compensation package including pension scheme, health insurance and performance bonus

• An active social environment and employee association arranging events throughout the year

Interested?

Send your application and CV via the application button. We look forward to hearing from you.

For more information, you are very welcome to contact Senior Business Consultant Erik Bernskov at erik.bernskov@actief-hartmanns.dk or by phone at +45 41 21 13 29. All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

Actief Hartmanns manages the entire recruitment process on behalf of Simatek A/S, and all contact regarding the position should therefore be directed to us. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of age, gender, disability, ethnic background, religion or nationality.

Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been identified.

About DBI Plastics

DBI Plastics Group A/S is a family-owned Danish company with approximately 200 employees, developing and manufacturing protective solutions for the automotive, machinery and engineering industries. We manufacture in Stenmagle, Denmark, and Swidnica, Poland, and serve customers worldwide, supported by our own warehouses in Shanghai and Detroit. We are undergoing a strategic transformation with a clear ambition: to double the size of the business over the next five years. A significant share of this growth will come from a segment we have not historically approached systematically: the many small and medium-sized customers who currently buy on a transactional basis. This is why we are creating this role.

The role

As Head of Transactional Business, you will have full commercial responsibility for DBI’s global transactional business – revenue, margin and growth across all small and medium-sized customers. This is a business-building role: our channels are at different stages of maturity, and your task will be to structure, professionalise and scale them. You will work through two channels: our webshop and a dealer and distributor network that needs to expand. At the same time, you will transform customer service from a reactive function into a proactive, sales-driving team. As a member of the management team, you will contribute to DBI’s overall strategic direction – not just your own area.

Your responsibilities

• Commercial ownership. Full responsibility for sales, budgets and forecasts for the small and medium-sized customer segment. You set targets, track progress and deliver results.

• E-commerce. End-to-end ownership of the webshop – product range, pricing, conversion, customer journey and digital self-service experience. You run it as a business, not as an IT project.

• Marketplaces. We want to increase our visibility on marketplaces such as Amazon and Alibaba.

• EDI and digital integration. Expand EDI connections with small and medium-sized customers to create a seamless, scalable order flow in collaboration with our operations and IT teams.

• Distribution channels. Select, onboard, negotiate contracts with and manage the performance of distributors – supported by a clear channel strategy that avoids conflict with our direct business.

• Customer service-led outbound sales. Build a culture and operating model in which customer service actively drives sales through upselling, repeat-purchase cycles, reactivating dormant customers and qualifying leads.

• People leadership. Lead the team supporting our transactional channels, providing visible, clear leadership and well-defined decision-making responsibilities.

• Management team. Play an active role in DBI’s management team and share responsibility for delivering our ambition to double the size of the business.

Your profile

Essential experience

• Proven experience in driving e-commerce commercially – ideally in B2B – with responsibility for revenue and conversion, not just the platform.

• Experience in building and developing distribution channels: identifying, negotiating with and managing distributors or dealers.

• Experience in customer service-led outbound sales – you have personally helped transform a service team from reactive to proactive.

• Leadership experience with direct people management responsibility, ideally at management team level.

Skills and personal qualities

• This is a highly hands-on role with a small team, so you must enjoy working both strategically and at a very practical, operational level.

• You are data-driven and take a structured approach to KPIs, pipeline management and channel economics.

• You make decisions – even when information is incomplete – and communicate them in a way others can understand and act on.

• You are equally comfortable in an industrial manufacturing environment and working with a digital commercial agenda.

• You work across borders and cultures and understand how a global footprint shapes sales.

• You are fluent in spoken and written English.

What we offer

• A newly created role with a genuine mandate to shape an entire business area.

• A seat on the management team, with direct access to the Managing Director and a short path to decisions.

• A family-owned company with long-standing customer relationships, high quality standards and an ambitious growth plan.

• A competitive employment package reflecting the responsibilities of the role.

How to apply

Apply on www.dbiplastics.com by 16 November 2026. We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply early.

Do you love turning menus and interfaces into something players actually enjoy clicking through, and want to own that from first sketch to final implementation? We’d love to talk to you.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

We're working on our most ambitious project to date: a new systemic open-world game built around a beloved IP, with our own spin on it. A bold new direction for us! And we're just getting started.

Now, we’re looking for a UI/UX Designer to join a team of around 15-20 people and own the UI/UX for the entire game. You’ll be the first dedicated UI/UX designer on the team (and at Triband generally!), so you’ll shape the game’s interface aesthetic and logic as well as player experience from the ground up.

**

• Maintain a consistent visual language and set of UI standards as the game grows

**You’re probably a good match if

**

• You have solid experience owning UI/UX work end to end, from flow through to final implementation

• You have strong Unity implementation skills and are comfortable taking your own UI work all the way into engine

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture.

• You’re up for experimentation, and at the same time you don’t get too precious when the experience tells you you’re wrong.

**Practicalities

• We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10–15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

**We offer

**Data Science Student in Strategy & Transformation

Who We Are

**NNIT is a niche specialist in IT for life sciences and highly regulated industries. We help pharma, biotech and medtech companies across Europe, the US and Asia, as well as public sector and regulated customers in Denmark, solve their most complex challenges where technology, regulation and business critical processes meet.

We are in the middle of a fundamental transformation. Our strategy, OneNNIT 2030, sets out how we will sharpen our position as a niche specialist, reshape our portfolio into a focused set of value pathways that take customers from advisory through implementation to managed services, bring our US and European organisations together as one, and become a genuinely AI-driven company.

The Strategy & Transformation Office leads that journey. It reports directly to our CEO, owns NNIT's strategy cycle, runs the transformation programme and builds the capabilities that will carry the momentum through to 2030. You’ll gain hands-on experience and insight into the energy markets that go beyond what you learn in the classroom. Along the way, you’ll help create solutions that enable our customers to grow their businesses.

Here’s what the job entails

As our new Junior Commercial Asset Manager, you will support our Commercial Asset Management and Origination teams, with a particular focus on Italian customers within renewables assets. You will contribute to a variety of commercial activities while gaining hands-on experience with the European energy markets. A key part of the role is also to engage with stakeholders, build relations and navigate across the entire organisation.

Furthermore, your responsibilities include:

• handling contract management and preparing tender and sales material

• joining customer meetings and contributing to solutions that support customer growth

• supporting planning, execution, and participation of commercial events, conferences and fairs

• collaborating closely with middle and back-office teams

• driving and participating in internal projects

The position is based in Copenhagen, alternatively Aarhus.

Meet your team

You will join our Commercial Asset Management team, dedicated to optimising Danske Commodities’ customer-related activities in Europe. The team collaborates closely with our Origination sales team to grow our customer business by for instance drafting contracts, managing tender processes and driving business development.

We share a deep understanding of energy markets and what our customers need. We keep an informal tone, and we believe teamwork is key to success. As a diverse team of market specialists across various European offices, nationalities and backgrounds, we bring together different perspectives to create real impact.

But enough about us… over to you!

As you will work on a variety of tasks and collaborate with different people across the organisation, we imagine that you are curious, structured and comfortable taking responsibility for your work. You enjoy working with others and find energy in supporting customers and colleagues.

Furthermore, we imagine that you:

• are enrolled in a relevant education within Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Energy Economics or similar

• are curious about energy markets and motivated to learn more

• can work approximately 15-20 hours a week

• are proficient in Italian and English – both written and spoken. If you speak any additional languages, we would love to hear about them

Please note that prior knowledge of the energy sector is not required for this role.

We’ll take good care of you

At Danske Commodities, we take great care of our people. Joining us means you’ll get a lot of great perks – including social events, cultural experiences, tasty food and benefits to better your health, your life and your future.

Here are some of the benefits we offer our employees:

Shape your development tailored growth plans, 100+ DC University courses & Harvard Learning access

100+ yearly events from office parties to DC Sports events, CS:GO team, student network & more

Global career paths as part of our parent company, Equinor’s 20,000-strong international network

Flexible work life to fit with your studies

Unlimited paid child’s sick days because family comes first

Free tickets & discounts culture, family fun, hotels, restaurants & more

Organic meals light breakfast, lunch, snacks, dinner & take-away

…. and much more

We're an energy trading and optimisation company that works at the intersection of technology and energy economics. Our disciplined and scalable trading strategies are designed to be competitive in volatile markets and create value for our partners.

We are looking for a Software Engineer who wants to build and ship new features that quickly reach customers, on top of an engine that already runs at scale. You join our platform team, which owns several live domains that our customers depend on every day. The foundations are solid and well maintained, so your time goes into new use cases and features rather than firefighting. Whether you have a couple of years of experience or a few more, we would like to see your application.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Hear directly from the people using what you build. Customer feedback feeds straight back into the roadmap, and you work on features and product decisions that matter to end users.

• Build on a system with real scale behind it. The event system spans 8 domains, exposes 20+ event types as webhooks, and powers 10 configurable alert types for our end users - currently ~20k active configurations triggering ~200k events every weekday. The team owns 8+ public APIs end to end, crucial for customers' day-to-day business.

• Learn from experts who share. You’ll join a talkative team of experienced domain experts who love discussing technical topics.

• Grow with support. Scoped, well-defined assignments to start, senior colleagues pairing and reviewing your work, and shared ownership of keeping things running.

• See your work ship. We favour small, frequent releases over long project cycles, so what you build lands in production fast.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend developer with strong Java skills who is at home on live production systems.

• Hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and REST APIs, in particular building and running your own services in a modern cloud-based microservice and event-driven architecture.

• You are comfortable working on live production systems with high data volumes and migration paths, keeping quality, observability, reliability, and performance in mind.

• You enjoy talking tech: you like discussing technical topics widely, learning, and listening in on topics not always directly related to your own tasks.

• You are motivated by incremental, high-quality delivery on products that are already live, bringing a fresh perspective that helps rework existing infrastructure where it is holding us back, and you treat the tools already in our platform as solid building blocks.

• Nice to have: Flink and stateful processing (or the willingness to learn it, since it is widely used here), relational databases, and Grafana and Prometheus, our “bread and butter”.

You embrace AI as part of how you engineer. From prototyping through to production, you use AI tools as an integrated part of your workflow, not as a shortcut but as a force multiplier. That said, this isn't the main thing we're hiring for: curiosity and a willingness to use it well matter more than deep prior experience.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Improve, extend and run the live domains our team owns, including telemetry storage and APIs, the event system, and the alerting engine, without disrupting production.

• Build and run your own services, with migration paths when architecture or data formats need to change.

• Work closely with the internal teams building products on top of the platform you help shape.

• Keep the platform reliable and observable at high data volumes.

****Our hiring process

****Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a lead engineer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

Ready to make an impact?

In this role, you will be part of a five-person Sales and Marketing team, reporting directly to the CCO.

Curious about the role, our culture, or how we hire? We’d love to chat. Reach out to Head of People & Culture Anne Heiberg, ah@worklinq.com.

**The Opportunity

**Veo's security surface is unusual. We train models on-premise on dedicated GPU infrastructure, run the product across AWS and GCP, and operate a fleet of tens of thousands of cameras deployed at clubs and venues worldwide. That is a scope most SaaS security engineers never touch: physical devices in the field, heavy on-prem compute, and multi-cloud production, all in one role.

We are forming a Security Enablement Team that makes it easier for every engineering and IT team at Veo to build, ship, and operate secure systems. As the most senior engineer on the team, you will own the technical direction of the platform security, identity, and network security slice, partnering with the teams that own these systems so security is built in from the start. As an enablement function, the team does not run these systems day to day. We build the paved roads, tooling, and patterns that let the owning teams operate securely by default.

You will join during a pivotal moment. We are standing the team up, defining what good looks like across platform security, identity, and network security, and rolling out the first paved roads for image scanning, SBOM generation, CVE response, CI/CD identity, and a unified internal network across our datacenters (GCP, AWS) and offices (Miami, Berlin, and Copenhagen). You'll have direct impact on how 100+ engineers write, review and ship secure systems.

**What You Will Do

We design the paved road, prove it works, and hand it to the team that will own it. We share ownership, pair on complex work, and rotate responsibilities, and we expect this role to set the bar.

• Design and build the paved roads for image scanning, SBOM generation, and CVE response, running inside the pipelines teams already use, with findings routed to the owners who can fix them under tracked SLAs

• Lead the design, reviews, and tooling for a unified internal network and VPN across GCP, AWS, and our Miami, Berlin, and Copenhagen offices, while the team that owns the network keeps running it

• Work with the auth service maintainers on identity and access, including MFA rollouts, removal of shared accounts, and cleanup of long-lived tokens, so the patterns stay theirs to own

• Make workload identity the paved road for CI/CD, using OIDC between GitHub Actions and AWS or GCP, packaged so teams can migrate themselves

• Build audit logging as a shared capability that teams plug into rather than reinvent

• Turn GRC controls into technical implementations, with evidence pipelines that produce auditable output without manual follow-up

• Own the contracting cycle for external penetration tests and build the intake, classification, and tracking system that routes findings to named owners, while the owning teams remediate

• Hand each capability off cleanly, with a runbook, a named owner, and an escalation path, and run office hours where product and platform teams can get a security review or a paved-road question answered

• Mentor the rest of the team and raise the security bar across Builders

• Network security at scale: you have designed and run a unified internal network across multiple cloud providers and offices, with a VPN approach that holds up
